recommendation.positioning_note: $99 flat undercuts Fivetran MAR pricing by 5-20x at moderate volume; price is the story.
risks: $99 may be too low for high-volume customers who would pay $500+ on Fivetran — consider usage ceiling or Team tier uplift
Meltano and Airbyte both offer free self-hosted tiers; pipewright must justify managed VPC value clearly
No SOC 2 blocks enterprise deals; note gap in sales conversations
